incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in fire, with flames visible through windows and roaring from the roof and porch area.

observations.description: Large flames consuming the roof and interior of the house, visible through windows and doorways.
Smoke rising from the roof and windows as the fire burns.
Roof appears damaged and partially collapsed; porch structure and siding are damaged by fire.
House with siding, windows, and a porch; a chimney is visible on the roof.
